blocks.text: I am opening this thread so that everything on the {{fact:f:E-2018-001.client}} investor relations program stays in one place and easy to find, and I have copied my colleagues so that we are all working from the same messages as the engagement gets underway. On our side, Laura Bradley will handle much of the drafting and keep the schedule straight, and Michelle Black will run the approval timelines so that nothing you need to see reaches you late or out of order. For the file, our point of contact with your office is you, Lauren Heath, and yours with us is me.

We have made a start on the message work, and I expect a first cut of the core narrative to you within the next couple of weeks. Before that draft hardens, one read from you would help us more than anything else at this stage: which audience we should lead with, since the investor story and the wider market story do not always want the same opening.
If it is easier to talk that through than to write it out, send me two or three windows and I will set a short call; otherwise a line back is plenty and we will build from there.
